title: Aggregate saved runs into a tidy dataset (per-topic outcomes, drift/nudge counts, tokens, latency) for the PRD §9 research analysis (Epic 14, issue #97)
prompt:
Write a script that reads runs/*.jsonl and aggregates per-topic outcomes, drift/nudge counts per side, tokens, and latency into a tidy dataset (CSV/parquet).

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

usage.summary: Read PRD §9/§5.8, LOG LogEvent schema, the three committed runs/*.jsonl end-to-end, the pricing/cost-breakdown + price-table config; TDD red-first synthetic-JSONL test; built the core/research aggregation package + thin CLI; ran it against the real runs; full gate suite.

note: Aggregates the committed runs/<run_id>.jsonl LOG event logs into a tidy one-row-per-run CSV for the PRD §9 results analysis. SOURCE OF TRUTH: only the JSONL event logs (the same machine log the teacher reviews), not a re-run engine or the .md files. Reading one log end-to-end (the 12.5 lesson) fixed the schema: per-message `tokens` is a COMBINED count (no input/output split, no per-model id), the topic lives in the `debate_setup` system event, and winner/`converged` in the `verdict` event. The runs dir ALSO holds package LOG chatter files (api.jsonl, models.jsonl, …) with no `event_type`; an `is_debate_run` filter (has a setup or verdict) cleanly excludes them so only the three real debates land. TDD RED-FIRST: packages/core/tests/test_runs_aggregation.py (10 tests, synthetic in-memory JSONL fixtures + a tmp PriceTable with distinctive numbers — never the committed runs, so the dataset files can change freely; no network/key), watched the import of agent_debate.core.research fail, then implemented to green. NEW packages/core/src/agent_debate/core/research/ subpackage, split FOUR ways under the 150-line cap (split, not compress): _summary.py (frozen RunSummary value object + RunSummary.empty), _parse.py (parse_run folds JSONL events via an _Accumulator + per-event-type handler table; is_debate_run filter), _aggregate.py (aggregate_runs walks runs_dir.glob('*.jsonl'), skips non-debate files, logs via LOG, returns rows sorted by run_id), _dataset.py (DATASET_COLUMNS single source of truth + summary_to_row + stdlib-csv write_dataset, float columns rounded so the committed CSV is clean/deterministic), __init__.py (public surface). NEW scripts/aggregate_runs.py: thin CLI mirroring scripts/generate_sample_runs.py (UTF-8 stream reconfigure, stdlib logging) with --runs-dir (default agent_debate.log.DEFAULT_RUNS_DIR) and --out (default runs/dataset/runs_summary.csv) flags — NO hard-coded magic paths. NO external API calls (reads existing files), so the Epic-13 gatekeeper rule is N/A (noted in the script + README docstrings). COST is an honest ESTIMATE: the JSONL lacks the input/output split needed for exact pricing, so est_cost_usd prices total_tokens at the configured debater model's INPUT rate from config/model_prices.json (config-driven, 0 hard-coded prices); input tokens dominate (~99.8k vs ~8k output on the policy run) so it tracks the real cost closely, and the exact per-model cost still lives in each <run_id>.md — the runs/dataset/README.md documents this caveat. DATASET: stdlib CSV, not parquet (pandas/pyarrow are not workspace deps; the acceptance criteria only need a dataset to EXIST, so adding a heavy dep just for this was rejected). Committed runs/dataset/runs_summary.csv (15 columns: run_id, topic, rounds, winner, converged, total_tokens, est_cost_usd, pro/con_messages, pro/con_nudges, total/avg_latency_ms, timeouts, retries) + runs/dataset/README.md (column dictionary + regenerate command + the cost caveat). RAN the CLI against the real runs/*.jsonl — 3 rows, winners match the known runs exactly: policy-congestion-pricing pro (107744 tok, ~$0.323 est), techethics-ai-art con (67173 tok, ~$0.202 est), lifestyle-morning-routine tie (76344 tok, ~$0.229 est); all three had 0 nudges/0 timeouts/0 retries in the committed transcripts. GATES GREEN: uv sync clean; ruff check . = All checks passed; ruff format --check . = all formatted; mypy = no issues in 236 source files; pytest --cov = 828 passed, 99% total coverage (research package 94%, all >=85); check_line_limit.py rc=0; secret_scan.py = only the live local .env (the documented pre-existing finding) — zero hits on any committed file incl. the new CSV. PRE-EXISTING failures unchanged (6 failed + 2 errors): branch-protection Unix perms x2, live-tree secret scan/hygiene x2 (real .env), Windows missing-file path-regex x2 (test_price_table, test_rate_limit_config), long-topic parametrized teardown errors x2 — NO new failures introduced. Files: NEW core/research/{__init__,_summary,_parse,_aggregate,_dataset}.py, core/tests/test_runs_aggregation.py, scripts/aggregate_runs.py, runs/dataset/runs_summary.csv, runs/dataset/README.md, this artifact; EDIT docs/PROMPTS.md (14.1 entry), docs/TASKS.md (14.1 [x]). Closes #97.
